footer_tagline: A full-stack AI admin template that ships with modern web tooling and best practices.
home_hero_description: {product} is a full-stack solution that helps you bootstrap React Router based AI projects. It bundles modern web best practices and tooling out of the box.
home_features_subtitle: Ship full-stack AI and admin dashboards fast, powered by modern web tooling and ready-to-use integrations.

home_features_item_5_description: Built-in performance optimizations and best practices

home_how_it_works_subtitle: Three steps to bootstrap your next full-stack project
home_how_it_works_step_1_description: Use git clone or the CLI to create a new project
home_how_it_works_step_2_description: Copy .env.example and configure the API keys and database connection
home_how_it_works_step_3_description: Run pnpm dev and open http://localhost:5173
home_testimonials_subtitle: Real feedback from the developer community
home_testimonials_content_1: The best React Router template I have used. The setup is simple, docs are clear, and I shipped an AI admin dashboard in a week. Highly recommended!
home_testimonials_content_2: Migrating our team from Remix to React Router v8 was painless. Hono integration made API development a pleasure.
home_testimonials_content_3: The out-of-the-box AI integration and polished UI components saved me a ton of repetition. The only nit is the official docs could be more thorough.
home_comparison_subtitle: React Router Antd Admin ships with everything you need out of the box
home_comparison_footer_subtitle: From frontend to backend, from AI to database — one template covers everything
home_video_demo_subtitle: A quick look at how to build modern full-stack apps with React Router Antd Admin
home_cta_eyebrow: Already helping 8,500+ developers bootstrap their projects

privacy_section_2_intro: The information we collect is used for the following purposes:
privacy_section_2_item_1: To provide and improve our services.

privacy_section_3_body: We implement various security measures to protect your personal information, including encryption and access controls. However, please note that no method of data transmission over the internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacy_section_4_intro: We will not sell your personal information to third parties. However, we may disclose your information in the following circumstances:
privacy_section_4_item_1: To comply with legal obligations or respond to government requests.
privacy_section_4_item_2: To protect our legal rights or the safety of our users.
privacy_section_4_item_3: To share with service providers that help us run our business.
privacy_section_5_body: We will retain your information for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Privacy Policy, or as required by law.
privacy_section_6_body: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information. If you wish to exercise these rights, please contact us.
privacy_section_7_body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated "Effective Date."
